description.fun: Zangoose and Seviper have been bitter enemies for generations, and every hair on a Zangoose's body stands on end if it so much as smells one. It fights with two long, sharp claws, and its strong immune system helps it resist venom. For all its hot blood, it's been known to enjoy quiet moments listening to ocean waves. The feud mirrors the real rivalry between mongooses and snakes.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon resembling a cross between a mongoose and a cat, and the sworn rival of Seviper. It lives in grasslands and savannas. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A cat-like mongoose locked in an age-old feud with Seviper
